description: Operational benchmark dashboard for end-to-end performance, client behavior, ingestion throughput, and system resource utilization.

panels.description: Wall-clock benchmark duration by adapter and scenario.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "benchmarks-telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["type"] == "spicebench")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "test_duration_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r["adapter_name"])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["scale_factor"] =~ /^${scale_factor:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => "${outcome}" == "All" or r["outcome"] == "${outcome}")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with
      legend: r["adapter_name"] + " - " + r["scenario"]
    }))
  |> group(columns: ["legend"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "legend"])

panels.title: Throughput (queries/sec)

panels.description: 99th percentile end-to-end request latency.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "benchmarks-telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["type"] == "spicebench")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "e2e_latency_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r["adapter_name"])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["scale_factor"] =~ /^${scale_factor:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => "${outcome}" == "All" or r["outcome"] == "${outcome}")
  |> toFloat()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with
      legend: r["adapter_name"] + " - " + r["scenario"]
    }))
  |> group(columns: ["legend"])
  |> window(every: 5m)
  |> quantile(q: 0.99, method: "estimate_tdigest")
  |> duplicate(column: "_stop", as: "_time")
  |> window(every: inf)
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "legend"])

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["type"] == "spicebench")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r["run_id"])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "sut_disk_write_ops")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r["adapter_name"])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r["run_id"], set: qualifying_run_ids))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with
      legend: r["adapter_name"] + " - " + r["scenario"]  + " - " + r["run_id"] 
    }))
  |> group(columns: ["legend"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "_time", "legend"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 30s, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
